_doc: Targets of the pass line (bench/deps_bench.py, `make bench-passline`). Data only. repo + commit: fetched into $BENCH_CACHE (default ~/.cache/rivus-bench/), never into this tree; the code of a target is never run (git clone/checkout, `go mod download`, `dart pub get`). args: the flags of `rivus analyze` besides -lang and -C (the default flags; `{root}` is the root of the fetched tree, for -allow-deps-under). time_limit_s / mem_cap_gb: the pass line. decided: false = the line is printed as INFO (the limits are not decided yet). detect: per vulnerability. mode location (memos): detected when a finding of the category has its source and its sink at the labelled positions of the truth file (bench/memos), at the pre-fix commit; quiet_after_fix is the count of the category at the fixed commit. mode through: see dart-pub.

memos._doc: Not a row of the pass line since 2026-11-25 (user decision: A, memos-4gib, is the same target with a stricter memory limit, so it contains the memory and the time of this row, and carries the same detect). The target stays for graph-check and --cost-check; run it by name only for reference.

memos-4gib._doc: Pass line A: the same as memos with `-max-memory 4GiB`, the default limit of a machine with 16 GB of physical memory (ADR-121): the same conditions as that machine. Time 180 s, peak of the process tree within 4 GiB, converged, detected (the same places as memos).

gitea._doc: Pass line C: Gitea v1.26.4 (go-gitea/gitea), the whole program with the default flags and the dependencies, `-no-project-rules`. Peak of the process tree within 8 GB, converged; time 600 s (the limit of the earlier runs, 10 minutes; 180 s has no ground for Gitea). Added for its size. detect.mode score: per published vulnerability of bench/gitea-cve-truth.json, judged by place (bench/score.py form: source function, sink file and line, functions on the path); the line prints `detected=<n>/3`, which is NOT part of PASS/FAIL, now or later (decided 2026-11-24: reference only; a regression of a memory change is checked by the sameness of the graph representation). The ledger row and the line carry the count n/3 only: no finding count, list, path or place.

cocoon._doc: flutter/cocoon `app_dart` (the server that manages the CI of Flutter). Launch: -C app_dart, -allow-deps-under the packages of the repository, `dart pub get` only, and the Flutter member of the root workspace removed in the COPY. No public fixed vulnerability of the project is known (no security advisory), so detected is n/a.

dart-pub._doc: dart-lang/pub at the parent of the fix of GHSA-q739-79rh-vmvp / CVE-2026-27704 (zip slip in extractTarGz; bench/dart-pub). detect.mode through: per vulnerability, detected when a finding passes through a labelled position of the truth file (bench/score.py --through); through_tp is the position count, information. INFO until its line is decided; the default-flags run does not converge today, so detected is no.

dart_services._doc: pass line D (user decision, 2026-11-24): converge within 600 s and 8 GB, default flags; detection is n/a (no public vulnerability). The limit of 600 s is for the same reason as Gitea (C): 180 s has no ground. Also a target of the depth experiments

smoke._doc: a small local tree (bench/go-curated), to check that the script works end to end; not a target

dart-archive._doc: brendan-duncan/archive (package:archive) at 3.3.7, the last affected version of CVE-2023-39139 / GHSA-9v85-q87q-g4vg (extractArchiveToDisk creates a symlink whose target is the stored name, with no check); 3.3.8 is the fixed version. Dart DETECTION target: detected per vulnerability (detect.mode through, truth bench/dart-archive/truth-6fc3b89f.json), builtin models (the entry-name sources of package:archive), default flags, `dart pub get` only; the code is never run. INFO until its line is decided. Quiet-after-fix is recorded (bench/dart-archive/README.md), not part of the line.
